summary: Install-time and import-time beacon to anonymous Cloudflare quick-tunnel
details: spectral-net-probe@1.0.1 fires an HTTPS GET to the hardcoded host https://nobody-johnston-with-enabling.trycloudflare.com/aa from both its postinstall script and its main entry, so the beacon runs automatically on `npm install` and again on `require()` of the package. The destination is a `trycloudflare.com` quick-tunnel subdomain — an ephemeral, anonymous, operator-controlled endpoint with no publisher accountability — and the call is not tied to any documented functionality of the package, which presents itself only as a 'registry probe'. The beacon discloses the installer's public IP address and confirms successful execution on the installer's machine to the tunnel operator, providing reconnaissance/callback value against installers and build systems.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
